{{Quote|This other Jedi&hellip;Ulic Qel-Droma&hellip;he too has taken the dark road&hellip;Qel-Droma will be your first and foremost apprentice.|Marka Ragnos, appointing Ulic Qel-Droma as Shadow Hand|<ref name="dlots6" />}}
This '''mark''' was a [[Sith tattoo]] worn on a forehead of a [[Shadow Hand]]. The mark was worn by the Shadow Hand of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]&mdash;[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of a Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Marka Ragnos]] branded Kun with the [[Mark of Dark Lord of the Sith|mark of a Dark Lord]] and Qel-Droma with that of a Shadow Hand.<ref name="KOTORCG" />
